description: The executable PostgreSQL harness never attempts a zero revision_key or a fractional amount_minor. The contract requires a real non-zero-key rejection assertion, and the missing invalid-input coverage allowed the fractional rounding/idempotency defect to pass while the harness reported PASS.

evidence.snippet: BASE_PAYLOAD uses only a non-zero revision key; the block tests exact retry, changed status, fresh-key correction, and re-entry without an invalid zero-key or fractional-amount call.
evidence.testName: source scan plus fresh npm run test:panel-score:postgres; harness reports PASS without the required invalid-input assertions
